## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10664 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T15:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10664, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same mechanism class: a fetch effect whose dependency list does not match the query it issues. Here it under-keys (`props.sort` is missing); the map over-keys. This card was read at source with no `reach:`, and the current gate folds such a finding into its family's closure card instead of dispatching it on its own (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110). objectui#10664 is that card, and it now carries this row (a sort change re-reads with the new `$orderby`) at `priority:p3`, serial after PR objectui#10649 like this card. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made.
